description.value: Hop 'n' Hog Tap & Smokehouse is a seasonal Canadian smokehouse in Clearwater, BC, at the entrance to Wells Gray Provincial Park just off Highway 5. The kitchen specializes in 16-hour alder and birch smoked beef brisket and pulled pork made with locally sourced BC ingredients, influenced by European charcuterie and Kansas BBQ traditions. Ten rotating draft taps pour locally sourced craft ales, lagers, and ciders, making it a substantial refuelling stop for cyclists exploring the North Thompson corridor.
